newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei futures end up, spreads dominate.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei futures end up, spreads dominate.

text.p: SIMEX Nikkei futures ended near their day highs on Friday in light featureless trade amid a lack of fresh leads, dealers said.
"The market has been quiet," a dealer with a Japanese bank said. "In the morning, most of the deals were concentrated on spreads. By noon, trading subsided."
News that Japan would try to cut debt issues for 1997/98 by over three trillion yen failed to move the market, dealers said.
They said the benchmark December Nikkei 225 contract found itself locked within 21,000 and 21,300, its key support and resistance levels.
December ended at 21,215, up 40 points from its previous close on 11,000 lots.
March ended at 21,255 against 21,215 previously. The dealer said most of the 2,555 lots traded in March comprised spread deals.
